title: Monday-session long in daily uptrend, flat by Monday close

source.title: Are There Any Simple Calendar Effects in Bitcoin Market?

rule_summary: Signals from closed daily candles plus the hourly clock. Condition: the last closed daily close is above its 50-day SMA of daily closes. Entry: buy at the 00:00 UTC bar open on Monday if the condition holds and no position is open. Exit: sell at the open of the Tuesday 00:00 UTC bar (i.e. hold exactly 24 hours), or earlier on a close-based stop when a closed 1h bar is 3% below entry. One trade per week per pair. Daily filter is daily; entry and exit are on the hourly chart.
mechanism: The source documents a higher Monday return and lower weekend volume in Bitcoin, likening it to currency markets, and suggests retail dominance causes inefficiency. It also found the effect inconsistent over time and concludes there is no reliable exploitable pattern. Closest honest mechanism: weekend thin liquidity lets sellers push price down and Monday's return of institutional flow restores it. A 24h Monday move must exceed 0.35% to pay, which is doubtful; this is a low-confidence diversifier.
